e: A postdoc using synchrotron coherent x-ray scattering and x-ray photon correlation spectroscopy to study dynamics in strongly correlated quantum materials (charge, spin and orbital order), with the BNL X-ray Scattering Group. Applicants need a PhD in physics, materials science, physical chemistry or a related field and no more than 5 years of postdoc/R&D experience; no citizenship limit is stated, but DOE credentialing is required.
